title: Service Recovery Amounts and Limits — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
Customer Care compensates a documented service failure with an instrument of **Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers** at the amount this schedule fixes for the failure. The schedule also fixes the increase for Summit Platinum, Summit Diamond and Summit Chairman members, the highest value a support agent may issue on one case, and the most service-recovery certificates one customer may receive within the rolling window.

## Amounts by service failure (US dollars)

| Service failure | Crestline Residual Travel Credit | Crestline Flight Credit | Crestline Trip Credit | Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate | Crestline Disruption Voucher | Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inoperative seat recline, tray or power outlet on a flown segment | 0 | 0 | 0 | 75 | 0 | 0 |
| Failed seatback or streaming entertainment system on a flown segment | 0 | 0 | 0 | 25 | 0 | 0 |
| Purchased Wi-Fi that did not work | 0 | 0 | 0 | 25 | 0 | 0 |
| Documented cabin cleanliness failure | 0 | 0 | 0 | 50 | 0 | 0 |
| Substantiated crew or agent conduct complaint | 0 | 0 | 0 | 100 | 0 | 0 |
| Pre-selected premium meal that was not boarded | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 0 | 0 |

## Limits and increase

| Figure | Crestline Residual Travel Credit | Crestline Flight Credit | Crestline Trip Credit | Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate | Crestline Disruption Voucher | Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Increase for Summit Platinum, Summit Diamond and Summit Chairman members (percent) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 50 | 0 | 0 |
| Highest value a support agent may issue on one case (USD) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 200 | 0 | 0 |
| Most service-recovery certificates per customer within the rolling window (count) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 | 0 | 0 |

## Reading the schedule

Only the Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate carries service-recovery amounts. The other five instruments show 0 for every failure and every limit. The rolling window is 365 calendar days ending on, and including, the date the new certificate would be issued.

**Hypothetical amounts.** For an inoperative seat the certificate amount is 75 US dollars, and a 50 percent increase takes it to 112.50 before rounding. For a crew conduct complaint the amount is 100, and a 50 percent increase takes it to 150. Both stay within the support-agent limit of 200.
